Cellular Automata as the Computational Basis

Brownian motion makes a rough world. A cellular automaton computes one.

iori1

1Jorik Jonathan Chase, 3DIE — Design, Art & Technologies Label. Paper 1 of a series. In preparation.

Abstract

In preparation. Paper 0 ends with a pointer to this one: Life, Langton's ant, Flame Strains and Petri as the evidence that local rules compute a rough world. This paper makes that pointer the subject. It asks what a rule can compute, and it measures the answers against numbers published by others rather than against the eye.

Planned contents

  1. Life, the ant, and what a rule can compute. Conway's rule, Langton's highway, Wolfram's classes, Rule 110 as a universal computer.
  2. Any automaton as a strain. Flame Strains: any 2D rule burns inside one volumetric flame, held at its size by a governor.
  3. Ten kernels, ninety organisms. Petri: growth kernels in WebGPU, organisms as data rows, every dish replayable bit for bit.
  4. Measured, not illustrated. The Tero fixture: Physarum on Tero's own Tokyo geometry, 21 replicates, inside the published spread on all three network statistics.
  5. The think tank. Many dishes on one GPU: replicates, competitions, sweeps.
  6. Criticality on a grid. The Ising model and its relatives as automata at the edge.

What already exists

  • Flame Strains: any 2D automaton burning in one volumetric flame.
  • Petri: ten WebGPU growth kernels and 93 organisms, a scorecard sealed version by version.
  • Game of Life: the ASCII edition.
  • Ember Engine: cellular automata fire.
  • Mycelium: fungal growth by automata.
  • Frost: a crystal engine.

The series

  • 0Fractal Optimization Through a Procedural LensOctober 2026

    Roughness: how to measure it, the simplest machine that makes it, and why image generators draw the big shapes first. Mandelbrot's Brownian casebook live, a theorem on the order of generation, and what the fractal toolset buys in speed.

  • 1Cellular Automata as the Computational Basisin preparation

    Local rules compute a rough world, measured against known answers: Flame Strains, Petri, the Tero fixture, the think tank.

  • 2Fractal Optimization of Tensor Landscapesin preparation

    Where the landscapes of neural network training are fractal, and whether that structure can be turned into speed the way multigrid and the FFT turn scale structure into speed.

  • 3Diffusion Over the Whole Documentin preparation

    Paper 0's theorem applied to text. Today's text generators write left to right, a token or a few at a time. Could a model draw a whole document coarse to fine, the outline first?

  • 4Lambda Cognition & the TIH Frameworkpublished December 2025

    The substrate: sparse interaction instead of dense matrices.
